1. Gather 1 Dark Oak Log.
2. Craft 4 Dark Oak Planks using the Dark Oak Log.
3. Use those 4 Dark Oak Planks to craft 1 Crafting Table.

This sequence achieves our goal of crafting a crafting table using the available recipes and materials.
